name: Dokodemo Dare to demo Sex Kyokashou THE GAME ~Masao no Yaritai Houdai 16-nin Haramase Bukatsudou~
original_name: どこでも誰とでもセックス許可証THE GAME～まさおのやりたい放題16人孕ませ部活動～
source:
Unpopular student Masao Itsuki is about to graduate high school.
The government has just issued him the W.S.L., a license to have sex
with any girl, any time, for the betterment of the nation.

"No way!" he cries and dashes out the door.

Girls... girls... girls... Young girls all over Kakumi Academy.
His school is one of the biggest, with thousands of students.
It's 3:00 pm. Afterclass activities are about to begin.
